recipe.visualDefinition: A classic 1960s pop music album cover featuring a central square portrait of a male singer in a suit, framed by white negative space containing bold red condensed typography and scattered lipstick kiss marks.
coreVisualRelationships: Central square image against a larger white square canvas
Bold red typography sandwiching the central image top and bottom
Repetitive lipstick mark icons acting as decorative framing elements
High-contrast color block header in red at the very top edge
coreInvariants: Vibrant red primary color for text and accents
White background for the outer frame
Textured, stamped appearance of the kiss marks

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central square portrait occupying approximately 50% of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central portrait's gaze and the large red title text above it.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical flow: Header bar -> Title -> Portrait -> Artist Name.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample white space surrounding the central photo to allow for graphic icons and text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red for all typographic and graphic elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep blue and warm skin tones within the central photograph.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation red against a neutral white, creating a punchy, commercial 1960s aesthetic.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Narrow 'O' and 'D' with straight vertical sides

composition.relationshipToImage: Framing the top and bottom edges

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different sizes for title and artist name.
graphicDevices: Lipstick kiss marks with a dry-brush or stamp texture
Thin horizontal rule lines in the header
Small geometric logos in the corners

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, condensed mid-century commercial feel.
Provides the clean, vertical sans-serif structure required.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a white square canvas. Place a thin red bar at the very top. In the center, place a square color photograph of a young man in a blue suit against a blue background. Scatter four red lipstick kiss marks with a textured stamp effect around the central photo.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using an ultra-condensed bold sans-serif font in bright red, center the title text in the upper white space and the artist name in the lower white space. Ensure all text is uppercase.

verificationChecks: Is the text ultra-condensed and bright red?
Is the central photo a perfect square?
Are the kiss marks textured like a stamp?
Is the overall layout symmetrical and centered?

mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original title

mustAchieve: High contrast between red and white

postGenerationChecks: Verify the red bar at the top edge
Confirm the square aspect ratio of the inner photo
Ensure the kiss marks look like ink stamps, not digital vectors
recipe.reuseFormula: Square central portrait + White frame + Red condensed uppercase text + Thematic stamp icons = 1960s Pop Aesthetic.
